title: Normalized signed Roos restriction and constant-tower unit
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, an open immersion e:V→W with site and coefficient universes independent, and an operation presentation o [def-sf-integral-open-operations]. In the actual categories and notation of [def-sf-augmented-strict-integral-completion], there are thetaW and thetaV identifying Q followed by the actual total derived inverse limit with the actual shifted-cone roosF followed by Q. Their K-injective, degreewise-injective computation maps equal Q of ordinaryRoosMap. There is a natural kappa from roosF then restriction to strict-tower restriction then roosF, equal to the canonical product comparison on each of the two signed coordinates. There is a natural lambda: Rlim_W then e* ≅ e* on towers then Rlim_V; its representative normalization is e*(thetaW) followed by the exact-functor computation comparison and Q(kappa), equal to lambda followed by Rlim of the tower computation comparison and thetaV. For every H, the target constant-tower adjunction unit at e*H followed by Rlim_V of the inverse constantRestriction isomorphism equals e* of the source constant-tower adjunction unit followed by lambda at Delta_W(H). This unit equation is independent of quotient reduction. This does not construct tau or compare actual module pullback with slice restriction. No bounds or quasi-compactness are assumed.

proof.text: Products are exact in both module categories by the pro-etale product theorem. Restriction is additive and exact and has the left adjoint $e_!$. For any family $M_n$ and module $Z$ on $V$, adjunction identifies $\operatorname{Hom}(Z,e^*\prod M_n)$ with $\operatorname{Hom}(e_!Z,\prod M_n)=\prod\operatorname{Hom}(e_!Z,M_n)=\prod\operatorname{Hom}(Z,e^*M_n)$. Thus the canonical product comparison is an isomorphism, normalized by its projections. Apply the exact-product strict-limit comparison to $F=e^*$. It supplies precisely $\lambda_N=\theta_{e^*N}^{-1}\kappa_Ne^*(\theta_N)$ in the stated signed coordinates. Its strict-augmentation clause applied to the identity augmentation of a constant tower intertwines the actual constant-tower units: both have signed coordinates (identity, zero). This gives the last equation without involving the quotient augmentation.

theorem openNormalizedRoosRestriction :
    ∃ (thetaW : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ rlim l E W ≅ roosF ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
      (thetaV : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ rlim l E V ≅ roosF ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
      (kappa : roosF (A := Modules l E W) ⋙ restrictCx l E e o ≅
      restrictTowCx l E e o ⋙ roosF (A := Modules l E V))
      (lambda : rlim l E W ⋙ restrictD l E e o ≅ restrictTowD l E e o ⋙ rlim l E V),
      (∀ I : CochainComplex (Towers l E W) ℤ, I.IsKInjective →
        (∀ p : ℤ, Injective (I.X p)) →
        (rlimUnitCx l E W).app I ≫ thetaW.hom.app I =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (ordinaryRoosMap l E W I)) ∧
      (∀ I : CochainComplex (Towers l E V) ℤ, I.IsKInjective →
        (∀ p : ℤ, Injective (I.X p)) →
        (rlimUnitCx l E V).app I ≫ thetaV.hom.app I =
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (ordinaryRoosMap l E V I)) ∧
      (∀ (N : CochainComplex (Towers l E W) ℤ) (p : ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        (kappa.hom.app N).f (p+1) ≫
            signedCoordinates l E V ((restrictTowCx l E e o).obj N) p ≫ biprod.fst ≫
            (Pi.π (fun k : ℕ ↦ ((restrictTowCx l E e o).obj N).asFunctor.obj (op k)) n).f
              (p+1) =
          (restrict l E e o).map (signedCoordinates l E W N p ≫ biprod.fst ≫
            (Pi.π (fun k : ℕ ↦ N.asFunctor.obj (op k)) n).f (p+1))) ∧
      (∀ (N : CochainComplex (Towers l E W) ℤ) (p : ℤ) (n : ℕ),
        (kappa.hom.app N).f (p+1) ≫
            signedCoordinates l E V ((restrictTowCx l E e o).obj N) p ≫ biprod.snd ≫
            (Pi.π (fun k : ℕ ↦ ((restrictTowCx l E e o).obj N).asFunctor.obj (op k)) n).f p =
          (restrict l E e o).map (signedCoordinates l E W N p ≫ biprod.snd ≫
            (Pi.π (fun k : ℕ ↦ N.asFunctor.obj (op k)) n).f p)) ∧
      (∀ N : CochainComplex (Towers l E W) ℤ,
        (restrictD l E e o).map (thetaW.hom.app N) ≫
            (restrict l E e o).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app (roosF.obj N) ≫
            DerivedCategory.Q.map (kappa.hom.app N) =
          lambda.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj N) ≫
            (rlim l E V).map ((restrictTow l E e o).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app N) ≫
            thetaV.hom.app ((restrictTowCx l E e o).obj N)) ∧
      (∀ H : DerivedCategory (Modules l E W),
        (constantAdjunction l E V).unit.app ((restrictD l E e o).obj H) ≫
            (rlim l E V).map ((constantRestriction l E e o).inv.app H) =
          (restrictD l E e o).map ((constantAdjunction l E W).unit.app H) ≫
            lambda.hom.app ((deltaD l E W).obj H))
